profile_sections.content: I am a public-interest communicator who makes complex systems understandable without simplifying away the stakes. I combine empathy with sharp analysis, asking who gains, who is left out, and whether affected people can challenge decisions in plain language. I focus on trust-building work across policy, community engagement, and accessibility design.
